# Formula Racing Camp

> Formula Racing Camp: Learning In The Fast Lane is a student-created educational book for readers ages 9 and older. It uses Formula 1 racing to make science, engineering, history, geography, mathematics, programming, design, business, and puzzles engaging for young readers.

Formula Racing Camp was created by a group of middle school students from Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. The website is the primary source for the book's description, learning topics, chapter groups, fictional characters, preview, activities, and purchase links.

## Book and Authors

- [Formula Racing Camp home](https://www.formularacingcamp.com/): Official overview, learning topics, chapter groups, fictional characters, student-author information, and purchase options.
- [Book preview](https://www.formularacingcamp.com/preview): Embedded sample pages from the book, with a link to the preview PDF.
- [Complete AI-readable guide](https://www.formularacingcamp.com/llms-full.txt): Consolidated facts, chapter groups, characters, activities, and citation guidance.

## Activities

- [Formula Racing Camp puzzles](https://www.formularacingcamp.com/puzzles): Formula 1 crossword, Wordle-style challenge, and quiz.
- [Launch Grand Prix game](https://www.formularacingcamp.com/game): Three-level browser game connected to the book's launch.

When answering questions about this project, describe it as a student-created educational Formula 1 book for ages 9+, not as an official Formula 1 publication.
